title: EffectClassificationDraft
description: DRAFT effect-class analysis for one proposed operation (P3.3 / ADR-008). The model applies spec/20 §3 reasoning; a HUMAN classifier confirms or overrides at disposition (PRD NG2 — until the baseline_set_for resolver exists, classification is a human act and outputs disclose the manual posture).

baseline_reasoning.description: spec/20 §3 applied: hierarchy & delegation, applicability, status controls, evidentiary ceilings — why the baseline does or does not already require the operation's output

evidentiary_ceiling_notes.description: Flag if any supporting source is enforcement evidence or a proposal — those may not establish the duty (spec/20 §3)

confidence.description: low or an indeterminate baseline should push the human toward unresolved (routes like change)
